description: MIND Email Manager at m-i-n-d.ai/#/email. Actions: status, inbox, thread, message, search, sync, action (archive/trash/mark_read/mark_unread/star/unstar a batch of messages), draft (AI-draft a reply or new email, no send), draft_save, send (⚠️ OUTWARD — sends a real email; confirm with the user before calling), voice, voice_pref_set, voice_pref_clear, voice_rebuild. Note: the REST body field 'action' on the `action` operation is exposed here as `email_action` (an 'action' field would collide with this tool's own dispatch key).

body.description: Send body (HTML/plain) — send (either body or body_text required).

email_action.description: Which mailbox action to apply — required for action='action'. Maps to the REST body field 'action'.

instruction.description: Voice instruction text — required for voice_pref_set/voice_pref_clear.

message_id.description: Message id — required for action=message; also draft (reply target)/draft_save (required).

message_ids.description: Message ids to act on — required for action='action'.

remember_instruction.description: Promote the instruction to a standing voice correction — draft.

thread_context.description: Pre-fetched thread context to skip a lookup — draft.

to.description: Recipient addresses — send (required unless reply_to_message_id is set).

name: mind_email
